Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 12 June 2025(Thursday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Metro Manila, Tarlac, Rizal, Laguna and Nueva Ecija within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Zambales, Batangas, Cavite, Pampanga, Bulacan and Quezon which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

data.text: #Philippines 🇵🇭 Severe flooding hit the Camaman-an area of ​​Cagayan de Oro City, Philippines, on June 10, 2025. Heavy rains associated with the southwest monsoon (Habagat) and a low pressure area caused flash floods, submerging streets and residential and commercial areas. Two vehicles, a jeepney and a motorcycle, were swept away by strong currents, and emergency crews carried out rescue operations for trapped residents.
